title: The Fields Sing
text: The fields you planted with pale seed have begun to sing at night. Your Seat's youngest have started sleepwalking out to them, lying down in the furrows to smile at the sky. The harvest is due, and it has never been heavier.

outcomes.text: It is the greatest harvest in the city's memory. Your youngest Scion sleeps through it in the furrows, waking with soil under their tongue and a new calm in their eyes.

options.label: Burn the fields, and the farm with them, to get your youngest back.

outcomes.text: The fields scream as they burn. Your House loses its farm and its harvest, but the youngest sleep in their beds again.

options.label: Lock the youngest in at night and leave the fields be until the harvest is in.

outcomes.text: All night they scratch at the doors. In the morning the fields are a little closer to the house.
